Mr. Lantz (Band Director) says practice assignments start being recorded in the band book the week of 9/14. Myles's Music/band day that week is Tue 9/15.

From this point forward, every band class needs: baritone, band book, and 2 pencils. Music stand stays home for practice.

Assembly rule: twist only — never push, pull, hit, or tap, and no tools. If he's forcing it, check the assembly videos:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaZYWFoeHvWYx4RF2NVs9XJ_kHLx-RuWj

Everything needs his first and last name on it — suitcase tag on the case, name inside the front cover of the band book.

Contact: Jamie Lantz, Band Director (Stonehouse, Norge, DJ Montague, Matoaka). Include Myles's full name, school, and teacher in any email.
